nodes.name: Daily at 07:00
nodes.notes: One run a day. The escalation ladder is derived from how far past due a sample is, not from a counter on the row.

nodes.name: Settings E
nodes.notes: Everything an operator changes lives here. Spreadsheet id and chat id are the two that must.

nodes.name: Read the register
nodes.notes: The only place the whole register is read. Once a day, and never during a decision.

nodes.name: Chase scan
nodes.notes: Reads the clock once and passes it in, so a chase run can be tested at any hour without moving the machine.

nodes.name: Nudge the grader
nodes.notes: Day one. Whoever has the sample hears about it first.

nodes.name: Escalate
nodes.notes: Day two. These were nudged yesterday and nothing moved.

nodes.name: Send the digest
nodes.notes: Three numbers worth having: how much moved, how long a decision took, and what is stuck.

parameters.content:
## Flow E: Chase

A sample that arrived and was never assessed breaks nothing. It just sits there.

Day one nudges whoever has it. Day two goes over their head. Monday brings a digest: what moved, how long decisions took, what is stuck.
